items.title: Lesson 2: Essence Style Principer
items.description:
Principles of Essence
- Essence is found through rigorous training and discipline
- Essence is found through playful exploration
- Essence is embracing and enhancing the Yin(Soft) in your Yang(hard) and vice versa
- Essence is feeling the prop and your audience through your core
- Essence Style is inclusive & offers a path for you to train in accordance with your own ability and body, We are as one. On one journey  together.

items.title: Lesson 3: Approach to developing something new
items.description:
When I develop a move. I often find a concept I want to explore. However once I do, I tend to turn my focus inside to what it feels like or what I want it to feel like.  
  
To me.. Learning a move should start with understanding the intention of it. The intention comes way before the handle, how you hold it and the head and how you swing it.  
  
It starts inside your body. Pay attention to it.

items.title: Lesson 3: Approach to learning

When someone teaches me a move. I tend to take it apart in as many small pieces as I can that can be practiced on their own. Because I want to take these individual pieces and find myself in them.

The move will be found in the symphony of your mind and body. Those.. Scales you've already learned allow for new expressions to emerge.
